title: Readability: handle_nntp_search response codes lack RFC documentation
description: handle_nntp_search (lines 1104-1153 in session/lifecycle.rs) returns NNTP codes (100, 412, 503, 501, 451) without documenting what each means or which RFC section defines them. Add doc comments to explain each response code's semantic (e.g. '412: no newsgroup selected per RFC 3977 §8.7.1').
